title: Base change of a localization is a localization
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $M\subseteq R$ a multiplicative subset, and $R\to R'$ a localization of $R$ at $M$ (every $s\in M$ maps to a unit; every element of $R'$ is $r/s$ with $r\in R$, $s\in M$; $r\mapsto0$ implies $sr=0$ for some $s\in M$). Let $\psi:R\to D$ be any homomorphism of commutative rings. Then the ring map $D\to D\otimes_RR'$, $d\mapsto d\otimes1$, is a localization of $D$ at the multiplicative subset $\psi(M)$ (in the same sense), so $D\otimes_RR'\cong\psi(M)^{-1}D$ as $D$-algebras.
